==Description==
'''Snowman''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious, c4rype and SoupedGun. The emote is not looped nor interactable. The player cannot move while doing this emote, and no music can be heard.

'''Snowman''' will make the player reach for the ground before pulling out the lower body of a snowman. After that, the upper body will appear on top of the lower body, already attached with a green and red striped scarf. Then, the player will grab out two sticks from their upper legs and place them onto the snowman as its hands. And finally, the player will grab the snowman's head out from the ground, which is already wearing a black and red banded tophat with the Paradoxum Games logo on the side, and place it onto the snowman, completing it. After this, the player can move around freely, and the completed snowman will stay in the lobby for 20 seconds before disappearing.

This emote could be obtained at Level 24 of the regular track, where it costs {{Bell|780}} or {{Robux|128}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Bell|8,990}} or {{Robux|2,145}}.

==Trivia==
*If performed in the correct spots, you can actually see that all the parts to building the snowman are hidden deep below the ground.
*If cancelled the emote while the player is still grabbing the snowman's head, the completed snowman will immediately appear.
**Using this technique, it is possible to get get 5 snowmen down before they start to despawn.
*The snowman's hat uses the {{RLinkC|11268435457384|Paradoxum Top Hat}} with a mistletoe.
